description:
A guided light-tackle fishing charter to the patch reefs of the Lower Keys aboard the 30' Jeanneau yacht. Snapper, grouper, jacks, and the occasional permit — all caught within a few miles of Key West. Your USCG-licensed captain doubles as your fishing guide: he knows the reefs by GPS coordinates AND by memory. All rods, reels, tackle, and live or cut bait included. Catch-clean-cook arrangements with local restaurants available on request.

Quick facts: 

• 4 hrs $1,395 
• 6 hrs $1,595 
• 8 hrs $1,795 
• Private 
• USCG-licensed captain 
• All gear included 
• Perry Hotel & Marina

what_is_not_included_items.value: Tipping the Captain and Crew: If you are satisfied, the minimum tip is typically not less than 20%.

itinerary:
Departure – Perry Hotel & Marina
Meet your captain at Dock A, Slip #32. After a safety briefing and gear overview, we cruise toward nearby patch reef systems.

Primary Patch Reef Fishing
Anchor or drift over productive reef structures located a few miles offshore. Drop lines directly over structure targeting snapper, grouper, porgies, hogfish (season permitting), and other reef species.

Technique Variation
Depending on conditions and bite patterns, we may incorporate:
• Light trolling for mackerel and bonito
• Seasonal mahi-mahi opportunities
• Drift fishing along reef edges

Return Cruise
Relax on the ride back with your catch on ice and stories to tell.

special_requirements:
• Primary booking party must be 21 years or older.
• Children under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
• Guests must be able to board the vessel independently or with minimal assistance.
• Bareboat charters (7–8 passengers) require a designated renter 21+ to complete the Bareboat Agreement prior to arrival.
• All guests must follow captain instructions during fishing activities.
restrictions:
• Fishing licenses are included under the vessel’s license (private charter coverage), although individual fishing licenses may be required by each fishing passenger.
• All catches must comply with Florida Fish & Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC) size and bag limits.
• Certain species may be seasonal or closed — regulations change.
• Not recommended for guests with severe back, neck, or mobility limitations.
• Excessive intoxication may result in denial of boarding or early termination without refund.
• Smoking or vaping is not permitted inside the cabin.
disclaimers:
• Fishing success varies daily and cannot be guaranteed.
• Target species depend on season, regulations, and conditions.
• All itineraries are subject to weather and captain discretion.
• Late arrivals may reduce charter time without refund.
• Six Fins is not responsible for lost, stolen, or damaged personal items.
• Failure to follow safety instructions may result in early termination without refund.
